SELECT contract_version, lifecycle_status, source_name, source_url, contacts_json, cover_attachment_id, cancelled_at, cancel_reason, publish_status, summary, event_type, edition_label, id, user_id, title, official_url, comment_count, like_count, view_count, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM public_event WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE public_event SET title = #{event.title}, summary = #{event.summary}, event_type = #{event.eventType}, source_name = #{event.sourceName}, source_url = #{event.sourceUrl}, official_url = #{event.officialUrl}, contacts_json = #{event.contactsJson}, cover_attachment_id = #{event.coverAttachmentId}, contract_version = contract_version + 1 WHERE id = #{event.id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE public_event SET publish_status = #{publishStatus}, lifecycle_status = #{lifecycleStatus}, contract_version = contract_version + 1, published_at = CASE WHEN #{publish} THEN NOW() ELSE published_at END, cancelled_at = CASE WHEN #{lifecycleStatus} = 2 THEN COALESCE(cancelled_at, NOW()) ELSE cancelled_at END WHERE id = #{id} AND contract_version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
